A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 17-page versions of the same ViDoRAG/ViDoSeek paper. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-D support reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original generation and retrieval experiments, component ablations, and efficiency analyses on ViDoSeek, plus SlideVQA-Refined evaluations (Tables 2-5; Figures 4-7).

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments and quantitative outcomes, including the ViDoSeek evaluations and SlideVQA-Refined results.

M1.justification: Section 5 retains the same GMM-based multimodal retrieval and Seeker, Inspector, and Answer agent procedures. The corresponding equations and Appendix D prompts are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both evaluate ViDoSeek and SlideVQA-Refined with the same content categories and reasoning tasks. Dataset construction, coverage, and Appendix B statistics are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains TextRAG, VisualRAG, and the oracle upper bound for the same backbones. Table 3 retains BM25, BGE-M3, NV-Embed-V2, VisRAG-Ret, ColPali, and ColQwen2.

E3.justification: Section 6.1 retains GPT-4o answer scoring, the correctness threshold of 4 out of 5, top-5 baseline retrieval, and the oracle setup. The GMM settings and 200-query scaling evaluation also remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The retrieval and generation ablations, GMM comparison, latency analysis, modality analysis, and test-time scaling analysis are identical (Tables 4-5; Figures 4-7).

E5.justification: Both retain the same point estimates and average-based reporting. No repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests are added or removed.

E6.justification: All reported results match. For example, Table 2 retains GPT-4o overall scores of 79.4 for ViDoRAG and 72.1 for VisualRAG, while Table 5 retains 6.76 average retrieved pages with GMM.

T1.justification: Sections 3 and 5 retain the same document/query definitions, bimodal GMM assumption, and Equations (1)-(8). No mathematical reasoning, assumptions, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same benchmark, hybrid retrieval, multi-agent reasoning, and state-of-the-art claims, including the stated improvement of over 10% on ViDoSeek.

C2.justification: The interpretations of retrieval noise, modality differences, latency, and scaling are unchanged. Both retain identical limitations concerning query-construction bias, computational overhead, and hallucinations.

D1.justification: The dataset/code link, backbone and OCR details, 8-A100/96-CPU-core hardware disclosure, GMM implementation settings, data construction instructions, and appendix prompts are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the bibliography retain the same cited works and positioning relative to visual document QA benchmarks and retrieval-augmented generation research.

P1.justification: V2 replaces the three institutional affiliations with Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group, removes the internship/contact-email footnote, and changes the corresponding-author marker. Author names, scientific prose, and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: V2 adds a small Tongyi logo, reformats the author block, and reflows text across pages 1-6. Scientific figures, tables, and captions are unchanged; rendered pages 7-17 are identical.

improvement.justification: V2 makes limited front-matter and layout edits while retaining the scientific text, methods, results, analyses, limitations, and reproducibility information, including all appendices. These edits do not materially improve or weaken the paper's overall quality.
